Role: Service Delivery Manager

Department: Managed Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

What is your goal? As a Service Delivery Manager, you are accountable for delivering high-quality managed services to international customers. You oversee complex service environments across Dynamics 365, Azure, integrations, and data, ensuring operational stability, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals, and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

• Lead and coach the DevOps customer support team.

• Own SLAs, service performance, budgets, escalations, and continuous improvement.

• Coordinate releases and resolve dependencies across functional and technical teams.

• Identify opportunities to improve and expand customer services.

• Contribute to service delivery standards and best practices within Managed Services.

**When Are We a Match?

****You Have

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience within Microsoft Dynamics 365 and enterprise managed services.

• Senior-level Service Delivery Management experience in complex customer environments.

• Proven ownership of multiple services across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data.

• Proven Release & Change Management experience, including release governance, CAB processes, and production deployment ownership.

• Experience managing SLAs, budgets, service quality, customer satisfaction, and escalations.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud solutions and modern service management practices.

• Experience working with international customers and distributed delivery teams.

• Commercial awareness and the ability to support service growth opportunities.

• Fluency in English.

**Strong Advantages

**

• Experience transitioning projects into managed service operations.

• Experience with Dynamics 365 One Version Management.

• ITIL certification or experience working for a Microsoft Partner.

**You Are

**

• Accountable and customer-focused.

• Able to oversee complex services involving multiple technologies and stakeholders.

• Calm and decisive when managing escalations and production risks.

• A strong communicator who can translate complex topics into clear decisions and actions.

• Collaborative, proactive, quality-minded and commercially aware.

****Development and growth

**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents and ambitions.

**Fun and success

**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

Are you passionate about app development with integration for hardware? Do you want to become part of an experienced development team of full stack software engineers and make your mark on Kamstrup’s Field Tools? Are you ready for an exciting and educational internship in an international green-tech company?

Here is what the job entails

During your internship, you will be working with your team as well as the Product Managers in our Project Team. Together, you will be developing our application for the Windows, Android and iOS platforms. This includes communication with our meters through a serial or wireless connection.

We are developing our apps in Microsoft Visual Studio - .NET/C# from where you will be working with one or more of the following technologies during your internship:

• .NET / C#

• Cross-platform development in .NET MAUI

• XAML

• SQL / SQLite

• MVVM design pattern

• Build pipelines in GitLab

• Bluetooth and wM-Bus communication

The specific contents of your tasks will be planned according to your wishes and your competencies and will depend on the features we will implement. Experience in the technologies we use is not a requirement; the most important thing is that you are eager to learn.

Meet your future team

As our Intern in .NET App Development, you will become a part of a software team in our Water business unit - Hardware department, consisting of five Software Developers with backgrounds such as Software Engineers and Physicists. The team develops meter configuration solutions and field tool applications for Windows, Android, and iOS. We are continuously working on improving and optimizing our field tools, so they become more user-friendly. By doing so, we ensure our position as a customer-preferred partner in the field.

Did you know? Only about half of our team drinks coffee — the rest run on pure code, energy drinks, or maybe just sheer willpower.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who is ready to work with applications and whose commitment and theoretical knowledge can contribute to further development across platforms.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Software Technology (IKT), Computer Science, or similar. Most importantly, you are passionate about developing applications

• Have an analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems

• Are proactive in seeking knowledge and value professional sparring

• Can work independently while being a strong team player

• Bring a critical sense that enables you to establish the best decision-making

As we are an international organisation it is important that you fluent in English both orally and written. Danish will be considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

Complex international HVAC projects demand more than strong project plans. They require disciplined commercial leadership, reliable cross-functional execution, and timely decisions across markets, contracts, and technical disciplines.

NOVENCO are looking for a Director of Project Execution to lead NOVENCO’s project portfolio across Denmark, Netherlands, UK, DACH, APAC and US. You will strengthen how we deliver safely, profitably, and consistently from order handover to final customer acceptance and satisfaction.

****Your Impact

• Lead the Project Execution function across NOVENCO, ensuring safe, timely, profitable, and contractually compliant delivery.

• Set the functional direction, operating model, governance standards, and long-term capability roadmap for Project Execution.

• Own portfolio performance across revenue, gross margin, cash flow, working capital, forecasting, risk, quality, and customer commitments.

• Lead and develop Project Managers and project execution teams through clear priorities, effective decision rights, succession planning, and coaching.

• Align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, installation, and commissioning around common delivery plans and commercial outcomes.

• Guide major customer escalations, contractual negotiations, claims, recovery actions, and commercial decisions within NOVENCO’s delegated authority framework.

****What Drives Success

• Extensive leadership experience from international HVAC, mechanical contracting, EPC, construction, or industrial project delivery.

• Proven accountability for a complex project portfolio, including margin, cash, risk, forecasting, contracts, and customer escalations.

• Strong financial and organizational judgement that turns business strategy into clear priorities, governance, and executable plans.

• The ability to lead experienced professionals and Project managers across functions, cultures, countries, and competing commercial priorities.

• A relevant degree or equivalent experience; PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2, or comparable certification is an advantage.

****Real Impact Example

****A major international project portfolio is facing changing customer requirements, capacity constraints, margin pressure, and several contractual interfaces. You enable your team to establish a fact-based portfolio review, clarify decision rights, strengthen change control, and align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and project leadership around a shared recovery plan. Within short time the team improves forecast accuracy, and brings critical projects back within their approved delivery plans. Just as importantly, the new governance becomes a repeatable standard across all four countries.

****What We Offer

• A leadership role with responsibility for international project execution across NOVENCO’s established markets.

• The opportunity to shape NOVENCO’s Project Execution strategy, operating model, leadership capability, and delivery standards.

• Direct influence on the commercial and operational performance of complex, technically demanding HVAC projects.

• Close collaboration with senior leadership and experienced colleagues across commercial, technical, financial, and operational functions.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

****You will lead a team of 8-10 people across NOVENCO and report directly to the CEO. The position combines strategic functional leadership with regular engagement in major projects and customer relationships.

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark - a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 200+ employees within the next 18 months.

It is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

They are looking for a Maintenance & Engineering Manager who will establish and execute an absolute, zero-compromise reliability strategy from day one.

The Role

As the Maintenance & Engineering Manager, you are responsible for the operational integrity, availability, and safety of all production assets and process equipment. Manufacturing rocket propellant leaves no room for trial and error—our process equipment must be predictable, fully mastered down to the individual component, and maintained at peak condition.

Reporting directly to the Chief Production Officer (CPO), you will lead the technical team in deep equipment mastery, anticipating service intervals with precision, and proactively replacing high-risk components before failures occur. You will work in close functional alignment with Process Engineering, Manufacturing Automation, EHS, Quality, and Production Planning to ensure seamless, compliant operations.

What You Will Do

1. Production Maintenance Strategy & Asset Management

• Develop and implement a preventive and predictive maintenance strategy for all production equipment, focusing on long-cycle and batch-based processes (mixers, thermal curing ovens, polymerization, climate-controlled chambers) to ensure thermal stability and high uptime.

• Minimize downtime by transitioning from reactive repairs to condition-based monitoring and planned interventions.

• Lead the selection, implementation, and management of a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to track work orders, asset history, and maintenance costs.

• Integrate maintenance requirements into the equipment acquisition process alongside QA, establishing preventive risk assessments and managing obsolescence planning.

2. Process Utilities & Production Support Engineering

• Oversee point-of-use process utilities directly feeding production lines, such as process vacuum, specialized process gas loops, and line-dedicated thermal fluids.

• Coordinate with internal and external facility teams on utility drop interfaces to ensure production machinery interface readiness.

3. EHS & Process Safety Compliance

• Enforce strict adherence to EHS standards across all equipment maintenance activities.

• Rigorously execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and "Permit to Work" systems on energetic material processing machinery and hazardous equipment zones.

4. Production Spare Parts & Technical Inventory

• Define critical spare parts strategies for production machinery to balance inventory costs with operational risk mitigation.

• Partner with the Warehouse team to track, store, and preserve technical production spares correctly.

• Monitor market lifecycle status for key equipment components and execute end-of-life obsolescence planning.

5. Team Leadership & Technical Development

• Lead, mentor, and schedule a team of production maintenance technicians and equipment specialists.

• Ensure the team is fully trained in safety protocols (ATEX, energetic materials) and advanced technical troubleshooting.

• Plan technician resources and build mechanical redundancy strategies to protect production during interventions or unplanned events.

6. Production Line CapEx & Commissioning Support

• Support the installation, mechanical integration, and commissioning of new production lines with Process Engineering and Automation.

• Provide early input on machine "serviceability and accessibility" during the design phase to eliminate future shop-floor bottlenecks.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

• Critical spare parts inventory analysis completed and gaps identified.

• Preventative Maintenance (PM) schedule established for all key production assets.

• Maintenance team skills matrix assessed and training plan initiated.

• Design of the “obtain equipment” process and equipment lifecycle framework completed in collaboration with QA.

What We Offer

• A rare career opportunity to lead the engineering and maintenance function for one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects.

• A role where your technical expertise directly determines the reliability and safety of high-stakes, safety-critical production.

• A professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose.

• Brand-new factory & equipment.

• Real authority, Greenfield impact, Zero toxic culture, Mastery over busywork.

• Top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

We Are Looking For

You are a highly structured, disciplined, and hands-on leader who thrives on the shop floor and maintains an absolute zero-compromise approach to equipment safety and operational reliability.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience: 5+ years of maintenance management experience within heavy industry, chemical processing, pharma, defense, or similar high-safety manufacturing environments.

• Leadership: Proven track record of managing technical teams, scheduling resources, and coordinating external contractors and facility service providers.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Experience working in highly regulated environments (ATEX, SEVESO, or similar energetic/hazardous contexts).

• Systems & Methods: Experience implementing or optimizing CMMS systems (e.g., SAP PM, Maximo) and utilizing OEE and Root Cause Analysis (FMEA, 8D, 5 Whys).

• Technical Mastery: Strong working knowledge of mechanical systems (hydraulics, pneumatics, rotating equipment), electrical systems, and industrial automation (PLC, SCADA).

Due to GDPR rules we are not allowed to receive CV or application through our email system.

jobs.occupation: Backend Engineer - Event Processing & Intelligence Services (C# / Python)
jobs.description:
Location: On-site with possibility to work remote

Team: Data & AI

Seniority: Mid-Level to Senior

**About The Platform

**Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.

You will work closely with colleagues in the Data & AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of event-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.

We are looking for a self-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.

Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

**What You Will Do

****Event Processing & Pipelines

**

• Build event-driven pipelines in C# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query

• Design processing that is correct under real-world conditions: retries, out-of-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at-least-once semantics

• Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems

• Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate

**Detection & Enrichment Services

**

• Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring

• Keep the signal-to-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty

• Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release

• Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product

**APIs & Integration

**

• Design and build the C# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services

• Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)

• Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers

• Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes

**Running What We Build

**

• Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer

• Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down

• Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own

**What You Bring

****Required Qualifications

**

• Solid experience with C#/.NET backend development

• Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python-first engineer, but you should be productive in it

• Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes

• Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment

• Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event-driven interfaces)

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C#/.NET production environment

• Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution

• Experience building multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge

• Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)

• Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability

**Nice to Have

****Experience with any of the following is a plus:

**Platform and engineering breadth

• Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)

• Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)

• Kubernetes and container-based deployments (Docker, AKS)

• Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)

• Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)

• Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)

• Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

• Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns

• Append-only / immutable data stores and time-series databases

**Domain

**

• Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)

• Rules engines or customer-configurable detection logic

• Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission-critical / regulated environments

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443

**Machine learning and data science

**

• Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning

• MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)

• Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies

• Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data

• Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control

**Why Join Us

**You will be joining an ambitious and fast-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. If you want to be part of building something meaningful with a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship, you will feel at home here.

If you are passionate about cutting-edge software development technologies, leading agile teams, the EV industry, and creating outstanding products, join Spirii’s fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Spirii is adopting agentic development as the way we build software. AI agents are becoming part of how our engineers design, code, test, review and operate systems. You'll make it real in your team, working with colleagues across engineering to shape how we do it.

You work very closely with a Product Manager and a Designer. Product owns what we build and why; you own how well the team delivers it. You report to the Head of Engineering.

Build a team where people trust each other, take ownership and do their best work at a sustainable pace.

Help your engineers grow, including senior engineers stepping into technical leadership.

Define with Product what good looks like, and track it with evidence such as delivery flow, reliability, and team health, not gut feeling.

Collaborate across Spirii

Who You Are

You care about people and want to build teams that grow, thrive and deliver.

You're genuinely excited about AI as the new way to build software. You want to be ahead of the curve, and you're curious about where it goes next.

jobs.description:
Introduction

We are looking for a talented Field Service Engineer based in Ballerup, Denmark or in Southern Germany. The ideal candidate has a minimum of 7 years of experience in servicing and maintaining scientific, analytical, biomedical, or laboratory equipment**.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Field Service Engineer to join Sophion Bioscience’s small, dedicated service team.

You will work alongside curious, hands-on colleagues who solve problems, share knowledge, and support one another - even when working independently in the field.

The team values high-quality work, clear communication, and a straightforward, respectful customer experience. In this key role, you will ensure the reliable performance of our automated patch clamp and organ-on-a-chip instruments at customer sites. Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs, system evaluations, customer training, and coordinating upgrades with cross-functional teams.

As an ambassador for Sophion, you will build strong customer relationships by communicating effectively and resolving technical issues promptly, helping drive the continued growth of Sophion Bioscience.

About Us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ On a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are driven by curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for helping scientists succeed. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share knowledge freely, support each other across roles and borders, and take pride in doing things properly. Our culture is informal, trusting, and grounded in respect — for colleagues, customers, and the science we enable. Even as we grow globally, we remain a company where people feel welcome, included, and able to make a meaningful impact.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

• Installation and Commissioning: Conducting on-site installation and commissioning of Sophion Automated Patch Clamp and Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring it meets the client's specifications and quality standards.

• Maintenance and Repairs: Performing routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of QPatch, Qube and Ethica M systems to ensure uninterrupted functionality. Responding promptly to service requests and providing timely resolutions.

• Documentation: Creating detailed service reports, documentation, and maintaining accurate records of all service activities. Providing feedback to the engineering and R&D teams for continuous product improvement.

• Training: Providing training to clients on the proper usage, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Sophion automated patch clamp & Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring they have a clear understanding of its features and capabilities.

• Customer Support: Serving as a point of contact for technical support, addressing client inquiries, and maintaining strong relationships with customers to enhance satisfaction.

• Collaboration: Collaborating with the Sales, Application Science and Engineering teams to communicate client feedback, potential product enhancements, and identify opportunities for upselling additional services or products.

Who You Are

You are an experienced service professional with a passion for customer success, technical excellence, and being a team player. You thrive in a hands-on environment where no two days are the same and enjoy executing your day-to-day responsibilities in close collaboration with the rest of the Sophion team.

We imagine that you:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Biomedical Engineering, a related field or equivalent certifications

• In-depth knowledge of liquid handling devices from various industry systems is a benefit.

• Experience with electrical and pneumatics preferred

• Must possess a good grasp of core engineering concepts which include the ability to read and interpret electrical/circuit Schematic drawings.

• Able to use test/measuring equipment like Digital Multimeter (DVM).

• Team player, critical thinker, and flexible for effective performance in the field.

• Experience with service management systems and processes

• Familiarity with the operation and maintenance of Festo pressure systems is a plus

• Manage MySQL and Oracle databases to ensure seamless system integration and performance.

• Network Configuration and Maintenance: configure and troubleshoot network setups, routers, and DHCP configurations to guarantee optimal system connectivity.

• Possess a basic understanding of Linux systems to address software and operating system-related challenges.

• Demonstrate excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities to address technical issues promptly.

• Communicate effectively with customers and colleagues, ensuring a positive and collaborative working place.

• Ability to travel 50-60% once initial training is complete.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact the HR Director, Helene Fife, (+45 51 20 34 43).

Start Date

As soon as possible.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
